_what: The capture contract between altair-os and the Altair Demo Tool. Every hook the video pipeline may target, declared by the app that owns the DOM. scripts/verify-capture-manifest.mjs proves each declared hook still exists in the source; the demo tool vendors a mirror of this file and refuses to reference anything outside it. Renaming or removing anything here is an API break for the capture pipeline - do it deliberately, in both repos.
_ownership: altair-os owns WHAT is stable (this file). The demo tool owns HOW to film it (flows, cameras, readiness gating, timing). Neither camera direction nor selectors belong in content plans.

breakpoints._note: Tailwind defaults - no custom breakpoints exist (no tailwind.config, no --breakpoint in globals.css). md is where the mobile nav rail and card lists give way to the sidebar and tables; lg is where the icon rail becomes the full sidebar and list pages become viewport-locked.

asyncContract._note: AsyncSection's pair: while loading the section carries {feature}-loading and aria-busy=true; when settled it carries {feature}-ready. Page skeletons additionally mark their root aria-busy=true so the demo tool's loading detector sees them.

map._note: Dispatch's Mapbox map. The handle and idle attribute exist for the capture pipeline: prefer window.__altairMap for camera moves over pointer drags, and wait for data-map-idle=true when the shot needs painted tiles (dispatch-map-panel-ready fires on GEOCODING, before tiles).

dashboard.notes: page-dashboard is display:none below md; the mobile landmark renders unconditionally ("All caught up" when empty).

dispatch.notes: ready = geocoded. Tiles painted = map.idleAttribute above.

tabs.control: role=tab within [aria-label="Sales views"], hidden below lg - deep-link on phone widths

invoices.notes: invoice-send-button renders only while the selected invoice is a draft; the send consumes the seeded draft (re-arm via demoDataReset).
